mapper.select: SELECT COM_SALES_YEAR AS comSalesYear, COM_SALES_AMOUNT AS comSalesAmount, ROUND( (COM_SALES_AMOUNT - LAG(COM_SALES_AMOUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY COM_SALES_YEAR)) / NULLIF(LAG(COM_SALES_AMOUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY COM_SALES_YEAR), 0) * 100, 2 ) AS growthRatePercent, ROUND(AVG(COM_SALES_AMOUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID), 2) AS avgSalesAmount FROM TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY_SALES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY COM_SALES_YEAR
